Try to tickle yourself right now. Go on.
But when someone else does it, you can't stop laughing.

text: Wait. Same fingers, same spot. So what's different?

You see, your brain predicts every move you make, before you make it.
It's like watching a horror movie you've already seen. You know exactly when the jump scare is coming.
So your brain just turns the feeling down.
Scientists even built a tickle robot. When it added a tiny delay, people's own tickles suddenly felt more ticklish.

text: Your brain is basically a spoiler for your own fingers.
